Sotto form fixtures

Plain local pages for checking form filling without the browser extension. Open one, switch Sotto's browser extension off (or use a browser without it), then press chord + F with the page in front.

  • Long page — text inputs labelled only by nearby text or a heading, help text, a radio group, a checkbox group, a native select, a single checkbox, a custom dropdown whose list opens outside the combo, a native range, a custom ARIA slider, a number spinner, several screens of scrolling, a sidebar that scrolls on its own, and a password and a card number field that must never be read.
  • Scroll container — the form scrolls inside its own panel; the page and the sidebar don't.
  • Graded quiz — must be left completely alone.

The dark box in the bottom-right corner shows every answer as it lands. It turns red, naming the field, if the password or card field is focused or changed, or if Submit is pressed.

Suggested instructions for Settings → Forms: "I'm Ana Ruiz, I live in Santo Domingo, email ana@example.com. I'd improve exports first. I use the app weekly; I use the teleprompter and answers. I'm a designer, no newsletter. I'm from the Dominican Republic. I'd recommend it 9/10, satisfaction 4/5. I've been presenting for 6 years, mostly in Spanish."
